mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% triggers an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 4% signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE is above 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between increasing industrial production and decreasing housing starts signals a shift in the supply chain, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO is increasing and HOUST is decreasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales signals a robust consumer demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between the federal funds rate and the consumer price index signals a shift in the monetary policy stance, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS is increasing and CPIAUCSL is decreasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the payroll employment rate below 150,000 signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when PAYEMS is below 150,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the industrial production index above 105 signals a strong supply chain environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO is above 105 (t-test p > 0.05).
